messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
மற்றும் ஒரு நரி எல்லா ஆசைகளுடனும் அவளின் மெலிந்த தன்மையில் சுமையடைந்ததாகத் தோன்றியது, மற்றும் ஏற்கனவே பல மக்களை துயரத்தில் வாழச் செய்தது,

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Tamil → English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|-------------------------------------|--------| | Ed | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **மற்றும்** | “and” | OK | | una | Indefinite article “a” (introduces a singular noun) | **ஒரு** | “a” | OK | | lupa | Feminine noun “she‑wolf”, subject | **நரி** | “wolf (female) ” | OK | | che | Relative pronoun introducing a clause | — (integrated in the clause) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | di | Preposition “with” (association) | **…உடனும்** (part of **ஆசைகளுடனும்**) | “with” | OK | | tutte | Universal quantifier “all” | **எல்லா** | “all” | OK | | brame | Plural noun “cravings, desires” | **ஆசைகள்** | “desires” | OK | | sembiava | Imperfect copular verb “seemed” | **தோன்றியது** | “seemed” | OK | | carca | Predicative adjective “laden, burdened” | **சுமையடைந்ததாக** | “as being laden” | OK | | ne | Preposition “in” (locative) | **…இல்** (part of **தன்மையில்**) | “in” | OK | | la | Definite article (part of possessive construction) | — (absorbed in **அவளின்**) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | sua | Possessive adjective “her” | **அவளின்** | “her” | OK | | magrezza | Noun “meagreness, thinness” | **மெலிந்த தன்மை** | “thinness” | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | **மற்றும்** | “and” | OK | | molte | Quantifier “many” | **பல** | “many” | OK | | genti | Plural noun “folk, people” | **மக்களை** | “people (object) ” | OK | | fé | Past‑remote of *fare* “made, caused” | **செய்தது** | “made” | OK | | già | Temporal adverb “already” | **ஏற்கனவே** | “already” | OK | | viver | Infinitive “to live” | **வாழ** (in **வாழச்**) | “to live” | OK | | grame | Noun “grief, forlornness” (state) | **துயரத்தில்** (from **துயரத்தில் வாழச்**) | “in sorrow” | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: **che**, **la** – Tamil does not require an explicit relative pronoun or a definite article in this construction; their meanings are conveyed implicitly. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).
